purpose: Country-specific game-start private enterprise allocation, separate from government baseline and commissioned production assets.

model.percentageMeaning: Modelled additional private starting factory units as a share of government starting units; not an observed private ownership statistic.
model.zeroPolicy: A government factory category with zero starting units receives exactly zero private units and zero company allocation.
model.missingPolicy: Missing source metrics stay null. Without comparable macro context or specialization, private allocation is zero.
model.companyAllocationPolicy: Five stable global identities receive private units using deterministic category affinity, country archetype and specialization; affinities are preferences, not restrictions.
model.sourcePolicy: Uses existing economicSectorContext and country specialization; it does not measure real ownership.
